notes: Zoka Quantic testnet: Ironwood (Halo 2, no trusted setup) with X-Wing note encryption from its first block. Test coins with no value.
Pre-genesis: there is no genesis block and no seed yet. The PC of the team will be the first seed once the genesis is created.
It never mixes with Zenith: it announces its own protocol id and uses its own gossip topics.
Its nodes listen on P2P port 28180 by default (Zenith uses 28080), so one machine can run both.
